_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ni wowe Umukinnyi {player_id} muri umukino wa Liar's Dice wa {num_players}.
Amanota:
- Ku ngaruka yawe, unaweza:
  1) Kugura ibidandi bushya na kiasi kikubwa cyangwa uso mwinshi (cyangwa byombi) kuruta ibidandi rya sasa; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kuyobora ibidandi rya nyuma ukwandikisha '[Call]'.

Ukiyobora:
  - Ikiwa ibikoresho bya uso uwo muri ibikoresho byose ni chini ya kiasi cyabidandiwe, umugurisha wa nyuma atakosa kibikoresho kimoja.
  - Ukoresha, uwitwa atakosa kibikoresho kimoja.
Umukinnyi wakageza kwa 0 ibikoresho atakuwekwa nje. Umukinnyi wa mwisho atsinda.

board.new_round:
Mwaka mushya - Ibikoresho bya dice bisigaye: {dice_summary}
Ibikoresho bya Dice yawe ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Umukinnyi {current_player_id} arapiga simu! Ibikoresho bya {face_value} ni {count}, ni chini ya {quantity}.
Umukinnyi {loser_id} (umugurisha wa nyuma) atakosa kibikoresho kimoja.
call.caller_loses:
Umukinnyi {current_player_id} arapiga simu! Ibikoresho bya {face_value} ni {count}, ni >= {quantity}.
Umukinnyi {loser_id} (uwitwa) atakosa kibikoresho kimoja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Witumiwe itari mwanzo yari imaze kubishyurwa.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Umurongo w'umukino utamenyekana kama umukino wemewe '[Bid: X, Y]' cyangwa '[Call]'. Umurongo w'umukino wakabiriwe: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ubwoko bushya {new_quantity} ni bugufi kuva na bushya {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Agaciro gashya k'amazina {new_face_value} ni gato ugereranyije n'aka kanya {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Igitekerezo cyo gutanga ni kimwe n'icyo ubu batanga.
bid_reason.face_range: Agaciro kacyo kagomba kuba kari hagati ya 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Umukinnyi {player_id} yarangije gukina kubera ko yari afite umukino utagira agaciro.
